Welcome to K9 Active Health with Dr. Adam, your go-to source for all things related to your furry friend's health, wellness, and active lifestyle! We've designed this channel with your best friend's well-being in mind, committed to delivering valuable content that's not just educational but also practical and actionable.

Dr. Adam is a certified animal chiropractor, with over a decade of professional experience. Having dedicated his life to the pursuit of health and well-being, Dr. Adam brings a wealth of knowledge to this platform. He's passionate about educating and empowering pet owners like you with accurate, up-to-date information to help you make informed decisions regarding your dog's health.

With the information provided it is our hope that this increased knowledge about your dog's health will help you make the decision of when your dog is in need of emergency care, vet care chiropractic care, rehab, and more.
